questions.text: Assume that transistor parameters are the same as described in Example 12.4. In addition, let N_{e} = 6 \times 10^{18} \text{ cm}^{-3}. Determine the base doping concentration such that the emitter injection efficiency is \gamma = 0.9950.

questions.text: Assume that transistor parameters are the same as described in Example 12.5. Determine the minimum base width x_{b} such that the base transport factor is a_{T} = 0.9980.
